Counselling

If you’re facing challenges in your relationships (family, personal, or professional), Living Systems counselling can help you better understand what’s happening and how to move forward with greater clarity.

Sessions are available for individuals, couples, and families, both online and in person. Living Systems’ goal is to make counselling accessible to all.

Training

Learn to better understand relationships, leadership, and emotional systems through training based on Bowen family systems theory.

Our programs are designed for clinicians, counsellors, ministry leaders, and individuals seeking deeper insight into how families, organizations, and communities function.

Explore Training & Courses

About Living Systems

Many of the challenges people face are shaped by the relationships and systems around them. Patterns within families, partnerships, workplaces, and communities influence how people think, feel, and respond. Understanding these patterns can bring clarity to situations that otherwise feel confusing or overwhelming.

For more than 50 years, Living Systems has helped individuals and professionals explore these dynamics through counselling and training grounded in Bowen family systems theory. The work focuses on helping people understand themselves in connection with others so they can move forward with greater clarity, confidence, and thoughtful intention.

Crisis Resources

Living Systems Counselling does not provide emergency or crisis services. If you are in immediate distress or experiencing thoughts of self-harm, support is available through the resources below. If you need immediate help, please contact a crisis support service or your local emergency department.
